Antecipação lets you receive credit-card sales before the normal settlement date. It covers credit sales, whether paid in full or in installments, so you don't have to wait for the standard period to get the money in your account [6].

- **How to request it:** You can advance your sales in the Getnet Brasil app, which has no extra fees to use [9].
- **Timing:** A schedule is open for advance from D+1 (one business day after the sale) until D-3 (three business days before the schedule settles) [8].
- **Hours:** For Santander account holders, you can check or request an advance Monday to Friday, 9am to 9pm, except holidays. Other banks have different hours [7].
- **Limits:** Some card brands can't be advanced through Getnet, only through the brand's own operator [8].
- **Automatic advance:** This is a condition for the exemption on the "Receba Conforme suas Vendas" plan. It goes through credit approval, and Getnet assesses each contract individually [2].
- **Loans with collateral (gravame):** If you take a loan, your sales from Getnet and other acquirers are paid into your Get Conta, up to the loan's outstanding balance [1].

Receivables advance lets you get your credit-card sales money, paid in full or in installments, before the normal settlement date [sup-duvidas-12].

- **How to request it:** Use the Getnet Brasil app. It has no extra fee to use [sup-duvidas-15].
- **Timing:** You can advance a schedule from D+1 (one business day after the sale) until D-3 (three business days before it settles) [sup-antecipacao-de-vendas-10].
- **Hours:** Monday to Friday, 9am to 9pm, except holidays. This is the schedule for Santander account holders. Other customers have a different table that I can't see [sup-antecipacao-de-vendas-17].
- **Limits:**
  - Some card brands can't be advanced through Getnet. Those need the brand's own operator [sup-antecipacao-de-vendas-10].
  - E-commerce advances are blocked for 6 months. Physical sales can still be advanced normally [sup-link-de-pagamento-12].
- **Loans:** If you take a loan secured by your receivables, the guarantee ("gravame") sends your sales to your Get Conta, up to the loan's outstanding balance [sup-antecipacao-de-vendas-05]. Automatic Advance depends on individual credit approval [sup-duvidas-100].

I couldn't find the advance fee or rate for physical-terminal sales. A human agent can confirm it if you'd like.

You can see the interest your customer would pay by simulating on the card machine: insert the card, enter the amount, then choose credit > crediário. The issuer approves the transaction when it is contracted [3].

Payment methods vary by source. One page lists debit, credit, Pix, Wallet and boleto [3]. The FAQ lists credit card, debit, QR Code and Pix [4]. Payment Link transactions must go through the antifraude [5].

Start by checking the chip and running a communication test; the passages cover both, and what to do beyond that depends on your machine model.

1. **Check the chip:** With the machine off, open the back cover and insert the chip in the slot marked SIM1 or SIM2, metal side facing down. Close the cover, turn the machine on and wait for the data network connection. When it shows a connected network (2G or 3G), it is ready to use [1].
2. **Run a communication test:** Press the function button (F, # or the one on your machine), select option 2 (maintenance), then option 1 (communication test) [6].
3. **If a connection error appears on screen:**
   - **ADQ 1-84 (signal fluctuation):** Press Function, enter 25, then the Operator Password, then select Function 46. The screen turns green after each step. Then make a test sale [7].
   - **ADQ 1-87 (chip registration error):** Confirm the chip is properly inserted. Then press Function, enter 25, enter the Merchant Password, select Function 46, then Function 90, and make a test sale [10].
   - **ADQ 1-19 (connection error during a transaction):** Press Function, enter 59, then select Function 25, enter the Operator Password, select Function 46, and make a test sale [9].
4. **Open a ticket:** I can propose opening a technical ticket for your machine with the reason "no connection" or "no signal". Nothing runs until you confirm, and the proposal expires after 15 minutes [policy:capabilities].

The passages don't say what to do if these steps fail, such as checking coverage in your area or switching chips.
